use_case: Dynamic ticket pricing: raises or lowers the price of each price level for reserved-seat Amphitheater and Music Hall shows as demand changes, within company-set limits
vendor_or_model: Ticketing platform vendor (machine-learning demand forecast module in SYS-01)
data_categories: Aggregate sales velocity, seats remaining, days to show, page views, queue size, floor and ceiling settings; no patron-level data (tested)
consequential_decision_category: None (same price for every buyer at a given time); re-tier High if patron-level data is ever used to set prices
human_in_the_loop: Today none (auto-apply). Conditions: floors and ceilings per show with artist caps; approval queue for changes over 25% in 24 hours; accessible seating removed from auto-apply and set daily at parity
applicable_laws: 16 CFR Part 464 (464.2 total price; 464.3 fees) (N71-R05); FTC Act Section 5 15 U.S.C. 45(a) (N71-R05); ADA Title III 28 CFR 36.302(f)(3) price parity; state surveillance-pricing laws not applicable while no personal data is used
status: In production since 2025-11 (61 shows); approved with conditions 2026-09-15; conditions due 2026-09-30

use_case: Bot detection and virtual queue: scores each session in high-demand on-sales, then allows, challenges, or blocks it, and randomizes queue position
vendor_or_model: Ticketing platform vendor (machine-learning risk scoring and queue module in SYS-01)
data_categories: Device and browser signals, network address and network type, request timing, account age; session records kept 30 days by the vendor
consequential_decision_category: None (access to one on-sale; box office and phone remain open)
human_in_the_loop: Automated per-session decisions; humans handle appeals and releases (logged) and review linked-account evidence before any order cancellation
applicable_laws: BOTS Act 15 U.S.C. 45c (protects the company as a ticket issuer); Fla. Stat. 817.36(5); FTC Act Section 5 15 U.S.C. 45(a) posted-limit and privacy statements (N71-R05); ADA Title III 28 CFR 36.302(f)(1)(ii) and (f)(4)
status: In production since 2024 (22 protected on-sales in 12 months); approved with conditions 2026-09-15; conditions due 2026-09-30 to 2026-12-31

use_case: Guest service chatbot on the website: answers questions about orders, refunds, venues, and accessible seating; looks up orders; hands off to staff
business_owner: Vice President of Marketing and Digital
vendor_or_model: Chatbot vendor (large language model with a retrieval knowledge base; SYS-15)
data_categories: Patron names, emails, order numbers, order details, free-text questions including accessibility needs; transcripts kept 1 year (vendor default)
consequential_decision_category: None (information and service); refunds and accessible seating changes are made by staff
human_in_the_loop: Refunds, exchanges, and accessible seating requests are handed to staff; required: identity check before order details and staff handling of all accessibility questions
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 15 U.S.C. 45(a), (n) (N71-R05); ADA Title III 28 CFR 36.302(f)(2) and (f)(8) (accuracy of accessible seating information); disclosure of AI interaction (company rule)
status: In production since 2026-02; approved with conditions 2026-09-15; accessibility handoff live 2026-09-08; identity check due 2026-10-31

use_case: CCTV crowd analytics: estimates crowd density in gate, concourse, and lawn zones and alerts the command post when thresholds are reached
vendor_or_model: Video management system vendor (computer vision module on on-premises analytics servers; SYS-10)
data_categories: Live CCTV video processed on premises; outputs are zone counts and density alerts kept 90 days; no face matching (feature switched off)
human_in_the_loop: Alerts are advisory; security supervisors and radio counts remain the primary control; the event commander decides every action
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 15 U.S.C. 45(n) (N71-R05); Fla. Stat. 501.171 and 501.702 only if face matching were enabled (whether templates computed from video are biometric data is unsettled; counsel to confirm and treat as biometric)
status: In production since 2026-04 at the Amphitheater and the Music Hall; approved with conditions 2026-09-15; validation due 2026-12-31

use_case: Marketing propensity scoring and generative copy: scores patrons' likelihood to buy for an event and drafts email and SMS copy
business_owner: Vice President of Marketing and Digital
vendor_or_model: Marketing platform vendor (scoring model and generative text features in SYS-12)
data_categories: Purchase history, email engagement, genre preferences, ZIP code; no card data and no sensitive data
consequential_decision_category: None (which marketing offers a patron receives)
human_in_the_loop: A marketing manager approves every segment and every message before sending
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 15 U.S.C. 45(a) (N71-R05); 16 CFR 464.2 for any price in generated copy (N71-R05)
status: In production since 2026-05; approved with conditions 2026-09-15; total-price check and privacy notice update due 2026-10-31
